text: @zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry 是 DSH Web 插件，在“设置 → 常规”添加模型请求重试次数设置行。它读取 active provider 的配置状态，并将一个非负整数重试预算写入适用的 normal provider；always 模式的 provider 保持无限重试。用户可以查看配置是否混合、正在保存或不可用，并在失焦时提交修改。适合需要统一调整多个模型提供方失败重试次数的 DSH Web 用户；不需要额外密钥或外部账号。

@zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry adds a retry count setting under Settings → General in DSH Web. It applies a non-negative retry budget to active normal model providers while keeping always-mode providers unlimited. Changes are saved when the field loses focus. No extra key or account is needed.
想在 DSH 常规设置里统一设定模型请求失败后的重试次数。
多个模型提供方的重试上限不一样，能不能一次调整适用的那些？
How can I change the retry budget for active model providers in the DSH web settings?
@zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry 的功能「统一重试次数」：在 Web 常规设置输入非负整数，失焦后应用于 active normal providers；always 模式仍无限重试。

@zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry README · @zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry：[](https://github.com/502399493zjw-lgtm/dsh-model-retry/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for configuring active providers' model-request retry budget from **Settings → General**.

> Compatibility: pinned to stock DSH `0.1.0-rc.8`. rc.8 moved retry ownership into provider profiles, so this version writes each active normal provider's `retryPolicy.maxRetries` through the published settings API.

@zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry README · Demo：The demo uses stock DSH `0.1.0-rc.8` and a plugin tarball packed from this source, all under an isolated `DSH_HOME`. It changes the retry budget from `2` to `5`, then uses DSH's deterministic local LLM mock to return retryable server errors on attempts 1–5 and succeed on attempt 6. Session-title generation is disabled so those six mock requests belong only to the demonstrated model request. DSH executes and reports the retries; the plugin owns the shared retry-budget setting.

@zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry README · Install：For stock rc.8:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry@0.1.0-rc.9
```

Restart Web after installation. Remove the plugin with:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry
```

@zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry README · Behavior：- Adds one numeric retry-count row to Settings → General and shows its provider scope.
- Accepts finite, non-negative integers, including `0`.
- Discovers active configurable providers through `llm.providers` and uses revision-fenced `settings.mutate` calls.
- Writes `retryPolicy.maxRetries` for normal/default policies while preserving existing backoff and retryable-code fields.
- Leaves `always` policies unlimited and leaves retry execution/backoff behavior owned by DSH.

@zhongjingwei/dsh-model-retry README · Development：```bash
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm run build
pnpm run verify:package

The package is an external Cordis plugin and does not patch DSH core.
